headlines.title: Will inflation boost Republicans’ chances in the midterm elections?
Biden’s Agenda Hangs in the Balance if Republicans Take Congress
headlines.abstract: On a wide array of issues like abortion, taxes, race and judges, President Biden’s opportunities would shrink as Republicans vow to dismantle much of his legislative accomplishments.

headlines.title: Progressive candidates score crucial wins in midterm elections
Early lessons from the US midterm elections as votes are still being counted
Republicans Gain Ground in Push to Take House as Democrats Hold Off Red Wave
headlines.abstract: Republicans picked up momentum in their drive for the House majority, but Democrats held crucial seats, dashing projections of a blood bath, and claimed a key Senate seat in Pennsylvania.
